metrics.name: bearing_deg
metrics.notes: Exact algebraic or categorical invariant; no measurement uncertainty is implied.

source.title: NOAA NWS wind direction convention
source.derivation: Meteorological wind FROM direction plus 180 degrees gives drift TOWARD direction; constant phase velocity gives displacement=wind*height/descent_rate.

model.description: The browser JavaScript production estimator. Each case records the exact model and assumptions identity that it exercises.
